instruction: Make a test job run only after a build job finishes using the needs keyword.
output:
name: build-then-test
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test

instruction: Chain three jobs: build, test, then deploy, each waiting for the previous one.
output:
name: three-stage
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh

instruction: Pass a version output from the build job into the test job with the needs context.
output:
name: job-output-pass
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - id: meta
        run: echo "version=2.3.1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Testing version ${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}"

instruction: Run a deploy job only when the upstream test job succeeded, using needs with an if condition.
output:
name: conditional-deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: needs.test.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh

instruction: Add a cleanup job with if: always() that runs even when earlier jobs fail.
output:
name: always-cleanup
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  cleanup:
    needs: build
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Releasing runner resources"

instruction: Send a notification job when the build job fails using if: failure().
output:
name: failure-notify
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  notify:
    needs: build
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Build failed for run ${{ github.run_id }}"

instruction: Fan out to two parallel jobs and join them in an aggregator job that needs both.
output:
name: fan-in
on: push
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make unit
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make integration
  report:
    needs: [unit, integration]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "All suites finished"

instruction: Create a release job that waits for both the linux and macos test jobs.
output:
name: multi-needs
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test-linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test-linux
  test-macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test-macos
  release:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/release.sh

instruction: Chain a version job into a build job that consumes the computed version string.
output:
name: version-chain
on: push
jobs:
  version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      semver: ${{ steps.bump.outputs.semver }}
    steps:
      - id: bump
        run: echo "semver=$(date +1.%Y.%m.%d)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  build:
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build VERSION=${{ needs.version.outputs.semver }}

instruction: Gate a publish job on the ref being a tag while depending on the test job.
output:
name: tag-publish-gate
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
  publish:
    needs: test
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/publish.sh

instruction: Run unit and end-to-end suites in parallel and finish with a summary job that always runs.
output:
name: parallel-then-summary
on: push
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run test:unit
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run test:e2e
  summary:
    needs: [unit, e2e]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "unit=${{ needs.unit.result }} e2e=${{ needs.e2e.result }}"

instruction: Hand an artifact from a build job to an integration test job with needs and download-artifact.
output:
name: needs-artifact
on: push
jobs:
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make package
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bundle
          path: bin/
  integration:
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bundle
          path: bin/
      - run: ./bin/integration-tests

instruction: Continue with a reporting job even if the upstream job was skipped.
output:
name: skipped-guard
on: push
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      ready: 'true'
    steps:
      - run: echo "ready=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  work:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.ready == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make work
  report:
    needs: work
    if: always() && needs.work.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Work completed"

instruction: Create a failure-analysis job that runs only when the build job fails and inspects its result.
output:
name: analyze-failure
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  analyze:
    needs: build
    if: always() && needs.build.result == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: logs
          path: logs/
        continue-on-error: true
      - run: echo "Investigating failed build ${{ github.run_id }}"

instruction: Expose an artifact digest from a build job and use it in a deploy job through needs outputs.
output:
name: digest-pass
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: build
        run: echo "digest=$(sha256sum app.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Deploying digest ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }}"

instruction: Run two independent jobs first and start a release job that requires both to succeed.
output:
name: dual-needs-release
on: push
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make lint
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make scan
  release:
    needs: [lint, security-scan]
    if: success()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/tag-release.sh

instruction: Build a four-stage pipeline where each job consumes an output from the previous stage.
output:
name: four-stage
on: push
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scope }}
    steps:
      - id: plan
        run: echo "scope=full" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  build:
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      artifact: app-${{ needs.plan.outputs.scope }}
    steps:
      - run: make build SCOPE=${{ needs.plan.outputs.scope }}
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make test ARTIFACT=${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact }}
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make deploy ARTIFACT=${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact }}

instruction: Restrict a dependent lint-fix job on pull requests to runs where lint succeeded.
output:
name: pr-dependent
on: pull_request
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make lint
  autofix:
    needs: lint
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.lint.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/autofix.sh

instruction: Wire a deploy job that runs after build and test and writes a deployment URL as an output.
output:
name: deploy-url-output
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make test
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    steps:
      - id: deploy
        run: echo "url=https://app.example.com/run/${{ github.run_number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  verify:
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: curl -sf "${{ needs.deploy.outputs.url }}"

instruction: Cancel overlapping workflow runs with a concurrency group while jobs still use needs ordering.
output:
name: concurrency-with-needs
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh
